title: ONE STEP SYNTHESIS OF A BULKY COMPOUND AND ITS ABILITY TO FORM INCLUSION CRYSTALS WITH SMALLER ORGANIC MOLECULES
abstract: Abstract                The reaction of terephthalaldehyde with 1,4-bis(mercaptomethyl) benzene leads to a novel macrocyclic thioacetal (1) which specifically and strongly forms inclusion crystals with organic solvents. The X-ray crystallographic examination of 1-benzene (2:3) complex revealed that the crystal is a crystalline solvate containing the benzene molecules as part of its lattice.
